 Bollywood Stars Including Janhvi Kapoor and Ananya Panday Gather at Dharma Productions Office for Annual Diwali Puja Celebrations
 Prominent Bollywood actors, including Janhvi Kapoor, Ananya Panday, and Shanaya Kapoor, gathered at the Dharma Productions office in Mumbai to participate in traditional Diwali festivities and mark the auspicious festival of lights with colleagues.
 Zoom TV Digital 
 Updated Nov 7, 2026, 06:10 PM IST
 A host of prominent Bollywood celebrities gathered at the Dharma Productions office in Mumbai to participate in the company's annual Diwali puja. The festive event saw several high-profile actors and industry figures arrive to mark the auspicious occasion, bringing a vibrant atmosphere to the production house's headquarters as they celebrated the festival of lights together.
 Among those spotted arriving for the celebrations were Janhvi Kapoor , Ananya Panday , and Shanaya Kapoor. The stars, dressed in traditional festive attire, were greeted by a large presence of media personnel and photographers who had gathered outside the premises to capture the arrivals. The event served as a moment for the film fraternity to come together and exchange seasonal greetings amidst the ongoing Diwali festivities.
 Celebrity Arrivals and Festive Atmosphere
 The arrival of the actors drew significant attention, with photographers requesting poses and capturing the traditional outfits worn by the guests. Despite the crowded scene outside the office, the celebrities maintained a festive spirit, offering Diwali wishes to the media and those present. The gathering highlighted the close-knit nature of the industry, as colleagues and friends assembled to observe the traditional rituals associated with the festival.
 Tradition and Industry Gatherings
 Diwali remains a significant time for production houses in the Indian film industry to host gatherings, fostering a sense of community and celebration. The event at the Dharma Productions office was marked by a blend of professional camaraderie and personal celebration, reflecting the broader cultural importance of the festival. As the stars made their way inside, the focus remained on the spirit of the occasion, with the attendees participating in the customary prayers and festivities that define the season.
